title: loop: pass the FULL task list to selectNextTicket — documented listReady pipeline strands every dep-bearing goal (R1)
description: Deep-review sweep #2 (2026-07-06) HIGH finding R1 (F1, adversarially confirmed). commands/loop.md:85-86 pipes listReady() output (todo-only; done deps excluded per src/task-store.js:317-336) into selectNextTicket, whose depsAreDone (src/drive-loop.js:42-49) rejects any ticket whose done dep is absent from the passed array. The "safe in either case" comment at src/drive-loop.js:13-14 is false and untested (tests/drive-loop.spec.js:96-113 never composes the two). Result: null ticket + goalStuck=false spins the no-progress counter to maxNoProgress=3 and the loop stops with a misleading "dependency cycle" reason; restart hits the same wall. 30+ existing tasks carry depends_on — the product's core flow fails via its own docs. Full context: state/sessions/20260524T000000Z-65fa92c6/artifacts/deep-review-synthesis-2026-07-06.md §R1.
acceptance_criteria: loop.md Step 2 (and any SKILL.md site mirroring the selection pipeline) instructs fetching the FULL task list (all statuses, e.g. readAllTasks/list_todos-equivalent including done tasks) as the input to selectNextTicket; no doc site composes listReady() into selectNextTicket anymore.
The false 'safe in either case' claim at src/drive-loop.js:13-14 is deleted or rewritten to state the true input contract (full task list including done dependencies).

A composed spec exists: given a todo ticket whose depends_on are all done, selectNextTicket selects it when passed the full list, and the spec reproduces the stranding (red-run evidence) when passed the listReady-filtered list — encoding the exact failure the docs used to instruct.

Consider and either implement or explicitly reject (with a comment) a defensive tweak in depsAreDone/selectNextTicket that fails loudly when a depends_on key is absent from the passed array rather than silently rejecting the ticket.
